title: Add investments, wallets, savings goals, and manual allocation
body:
## Summary
- Reworks the salary reserve language from protected buffer to “страховка / чёрный день” while preserving the existing DB field for compatibility.
- Adds persistent finance controls: investments monthly updates, monthly wallets, manual allocation plan, and per-wish `savedAmount` savings progress.
- Removes timeline from navigation, adds wishlist filters, and improves scenario cards with reserve/investment split visibility and revised scenario math.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/1fac82730d634902914c0233c5726533
